efficacy_outcome: At 8 weeks, versus placebo, curcumin significantly reduced CML (148 ± 108 vs 197 ± 101 ng/mL; P=0.04), 8-OHdG (46.9 ± 31.1 vs 52.1 ± 43.1 ng/mL; P=0.03), liver enzymes (P<0.001), and several anthropometric measures. It did not significantly change sRAGE, hip circumference, waist/hip ratio, or fat-free mass.
